steps: Preheat oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Peel and cube Sweet potato into 2 cm pieces; cut Broccoli into small florets.
Mince Garlic and whisk together with Olive oil, Lemon juice, Paprika, and Salt in a small bowl.
Toss Sweet potato cubes with half the olive oil mixture; spread on one side of the baking sheet.
Roast Sweet potato 15 minutes until beginning to soften.
Add Broccoli and Salmon portions to the baking sheet; drizzle remaining olive oil mixture over all.
Roast 12 to 15 minutes until Salmon flakes easily and Sweet potato is golden and tender.
Sprinkle Fresh dill over everything before serving. Yield: 4 family portions. Refrigerate leftovers up to 2 days.
